text:
ella: low-key idea  sake flight + karaoke night at the lounge next Thu 7pm? small covers, prizes for best duet. interested? :microphone::sake:

pete: sounds fun. i'll volunteer to coordinate the song list. :notes:

ravi: in. can we have a non-alcoholic flight option for folks who don't drink?

zoe: yes please. also allergic to soy so any sushi sides need a heads-up.

harper: can we keep it to 2-song max per person so everyone gets a turn?

ben: love that rule. also suggest a "duet roulette" where pairs get assigned random genres. could be hilarious. :joy:

ella: love duet roulette. planning: 7-9pm, signups on a sheet, small $5 suggested donation to cover flight samples. react :one: if you can donate $5, :two: if maybe.

pete: :one: happy to chip in. i'll also bring a small bluetooth mic for stage effect.

ops-bot: Reminder: For team-socials purchases, submit `/expense submit --amount <total> --category team-socials --notes "sake + karaoke"`. Small donations can be pooled; attach receipts.

zoe: accessibility note: lounge has one step up to the stage. can facilities provide a small ramp?

facilities: We can provide a portable ramp and a cordless mic stand. Please request by Tue noon to ensure setup.

harper: also noise curfew? neighbors might complain. can we cap the stereo after 8:45?

ella: good call. set soft volume after 8:45 and end by 9:15 latest. i'll note that in the event page.

pete: making a quick song signup sheet: https://tiny.redwood/sake-karaoke-signup  add song(s), duet preference, +1s, and donation status. closing Wed 4pm.

ravi: dietary note: if we do small sushi bites, can we include a veggie option and gluten-free soy alternatives?

ben: i can bring rice crackers and a veggie platter. also happy to handle prizes  small coffee cards + stickers.

ella: volunteers for setup/cleanup? react :hand: if you can help 15 min before/after.

pete: :hand: i'll help with mics and speakers.

zoe: :hand: i'll help with sign-up sheet and donor tracking.

harper: question: is this ok for all teams? some folks might want quieter weeknights. maybe make it optional and short.

ella: yep optional. keeping it short and friendly. plan: intro flight tasting at 7pm, karaoke opens 7:20, duet roulette around 8:15, wind down by 9:15.

ops-bot: Budget note: events under $150 auto-approve. If pooled donations exceed organizer cover, submit for reimbursement within 7 days.

facilities: Confirmed stage ramp availability if requested by Tue. Also we can reserve lounge and post a small sign for sound curfew.

pete: one last thing  anyone want to co-host duet roulette with me? keeps it fair.

ben: i'll co-host.

ravi: RSVP +1 (bringing Aisha). added to the sheet.

zoe: RSVP. donated $5. added soy allergy note.

harper: RSVP. two songs queued.

ella: sweet. final reminders: add songs, donate if you can, request ramp by Tue if needed, and respect the quiet hours. excited! :sparkles:
